45 ("Joseph Given Charge of Egypt")?
In Laurie's devotional, he quotes Genesis 41:38, but then he quickly pivots:
"One moment Joseph was in prison, and the next moment he found himself standing before Pharaoh... Joseph wasn't ashamed to tell Pharaoh the truth. He spoke boldly to him. And Joseph's example is good to remember when we're sharing the gospel... Elijah... If you kneel before God, you can stand before any man."
In PowerPoint's devotional, he quotes Genesis 41:38:
"And Pharaoh said to his servants, 'Can we find a man like this, in whom is the Spirit of God?' -- Genesis 41:38
A life of significance is marked by an overriding sense of direction... Pharaoh noticed that there was a different spirit in Joseph... because the Spirit of God was living in him... giving him a different, high-energy spirit about life..."
In Ligonier's devotional:
"Joseph's Ascendancy"
Main text: Genesis 41:37-45 (quoting 41:38-39).
It discusses Joseph's proposal pleasing Pharaoh (v. 37), Pharaoh recognizing the Spirit of God (v. 38), placing Joseph over Egypt (vv. 40-41), giving him the signet ring, fine linen, gold chain, and chariot (vv. 42-43), and giving him an Egyptian name and wife (v. 45). Then the Coram Deo devotional takeaway on living by the Spirit.
